title: Show the exact Git-input remedy when evaluated completion omits its declaration
outcome: Make show and completion recovery explain that registered Git-input evaluation completion needs the exact declared git-commit:/git-tree: input even when freshness policy is off, preserving legacy measurement guidance.
acceptance: For an evaluated registered Git-input pass with source freshness disabled, show exposes that done checks the declared source input.

When done omits --source-fingerprint in that lane, the remedy tells the caller to present the evaluation's exact Git declaration or re-evaluate the intended input; it does not require copying to masquerade as a host measurement.
Regression tests exercise omitted completion input and assert truthful guidance while legacy measurement refusals retain their existing safety meaning.
